The main takeaway from our work is that
the B7H costimulation is sufficient to induce CTL-mediated tumor rejection in vivo.
the B7H costimulation of CTL is more efficient in vivo than in vitro, and that the in vivo costimulation is not restricted to the APCs that express B7H.
